UNFOLDING CASE STUDY: OXYGENATION

The nurse cares for a 78-year-old female admitted to the medical intensive care unit in respiratory distress.

Nurses' Notes

0900. Client was admitted to the ICU in respiratory distress after minimal response to high flow oxygen for a pulse oximeter reading of 83% in room air. Crackles heard bilaterally in lower lobes with diminished breath sounds in right middle lobe; S1S2 auscultated; bowel sounds positive in all 4 quadrants; skin warm dry and intact. VS T 99.8F(37.7C); HR 110; RR 34; B/P 148/90; pulse oximeter is 87% on 100% non-rebreather; pain-0/10. Laboratory Report

Lab ABG pH ABG POz ABG PCO2 ABG HCOs WBC Platelets Potassium(serum) Sodium (serum) Magnesium Blood culture Urine culture Sputum culture

Results 7.2 75 mm Hg 51 mm Hg 28 mEq/L 35,000 cells/mm 250,000/ mm 4.0 mEq/L 140 mEg/L 1.5 mEq/L Gram negative cocci pending pending
